retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

score.note: player 1 score, BCD (RetroAchievements leaderboard "MS5 Hi-Score", from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, BCD, eight bytes after player 1's as in Metal Slug 4 (Seb's two-player game of 7 November 22:59 (memory recording and 225 screenshots), 1.33 test 43: 500 at 54 s as on his screenshot, 24701 at 300 s, 40103 at the end)

lives.note: player 1 lives, like the 1UP on screen (X2 with 2 and X1 with 1 on his screenshots, Seb's two-player game of 7 November 22:59 (memory recording and 225 screenshots), 1.33 test 43); 0 for 17 s before the game writes them at the first mission

lives_p2.note: player 2 lives, like the 2UP on screen (X2 and X1 on his screenshots, Seb's two-player game of 7 November 22:59 (memory recording and 225 screenshots), 1.33 test 43)

grenades_out.note: player 1 grenades on screen, six bytes before his bombs as in Metal Slug 4 (Seb's two-player game of 7 November 22:59 (memory recording and 225 screenshots), 1.33 test 43: 1 or 2 after each bombs decrease, 0 again as they blow up, 0 the rest of the time)

grenades_out_p2.note: player 2 grenades on screen, six bytes before his bombs, deduced

weapon.note: player 1 weapon (RetroAchievements code notes): 0 handgun, 2 shotgun, 3 rocket launcher, 4 flame shot, 5 heavy machine gun, 6 laser, 8 super rocket launcher, 11 super laser, 12 enemy chaser, 13 iron lizard, 14 drop shot, 15 super grenade, 0x12 two machine guns, 0x1D super shotgun; the same codes as Metal Slug 3

prisoners.note: player 1 rescued prisoners (cheat database, Always have 15 Prisoners PL1)

p1_chr.note: player 1 soldier: 0 Marco, 1 Tarma, 2 Eri, 3 Fio (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 - Character, address swapped, right before his lives); to confirm in game

p2_chr.note: player 2 soldier, same codes, deduced: his block is 0xC4 further (lives)

prisoners_p2.note: player 2 prisoners, deduced from player 1's 'Current POWs [Value 1]' of the RetroAchievements notes (0x100A48) 0xC4 further; to confirm in game

vehicle_kind.note: player 1 vehicle (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 - Slug Vehicle ID, address swapped): 1 on foot, 4 Slug Walker or Metal Slug, 6 Slug Flyer or Slug Car, 14 Augensterm; to confirm in game

vehicle.note: player 1 in a vehicle: the same byte less one, 0 on foot, 3 and more aboard

vehicle_kind_p2.note: player 2 vehicle, same codes, deduced (0xC4 further)

vehicle_p2.note: player 2 in a vehicle, the same byte less one

vehicle_hp.note: energy of player 1's vehicle in % (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 - Tank Health HUD, the high byte of a word; 48 full as in Metal Slug 4)

vehicle_hp_p2.note: energy of player 2's vehicle, his block 0xC4 further (Seb's two-player game of 7 November 22:59 (memory recording and 225 screenshots), 1.33 test 43: 40 then 48 as he got into the Slug Gunner at 258 s, 30 then 32 after a hit, 0 again when he left it at 329 s)

_hps.note: the lives of the game's objects (Seb's two-player game of 7 November 22:59 (memory recording and 225 screenshots), 1.33 test 43): a table of 196-byte entries from 0x100E28 to 0x103B54, the life word at the offset of the Metal Rear's (0x101F00); soldiers and small enemies hold 10 to 40, bigger ones 100 to 320; the Metal Rear came with 6500 in two entries at once (0x101F00 and 0x1029B8, the same value all along, one of them a twin) for two players, down to 0 at 429.0 s as the game's boss flag rose

boss_down.note: 1 once the mission's boss is defeated, 0 again at the next mission (RetroAchievements code notes, Game - Boss Defeated flag; Seb's two-player game of 7 November 22:59 (memory recording and 225 screenshots), 1.33 test 43: 1 at 429.0 s)

fade.note: the screen fade counter (RetroAchievements code notes, Game - Screen Fade Out): 255 while playing, 157 down to 0 over the MISSION COMPLETE text and the fade to the next mission (Seb's two-player game of 7 November 22:59 (memory recording and 225 screenshots), 1.33 test 43: 439.6 s to 446 s, the text on his screenshot), 10 down to 0 over the boss's explosion flash at 432 s

section.note: probe: Mission - Section of the RetroAchievements code notes (8 all along mission 1 of Seb's game)

_p1b.note: probe (1.33 test 21): player 1's block (tank energy 0x100A31 and 0x100A33 of the notes, soldier, lives, HUD state, vehicle, grenades, prisoners), to confirm from a capture

mission.note: mission number, 0-based in RAM (cheat database "Select Starting Mission"), to be confirmed in game, missions 1 to 5: another value is not read (Metal Slug read 183 while it booted)

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

p1_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 1 stick and buttons (P1CURRENT): 0x04 left, 0x08 right, 0x10 A. Fires the handgun and scrolls the HD backdrop, to be confirmed in game

p2_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 2 stick and buttons (P2CURRENT), same bits

hd.note: where the bosses' lives are: the whole table of objects (_hps). A life of 2000 or more is the mission's boss, named after the mission (Metal Rear 6500 for two players in Seb's game; the start for one player not seen yet, so no boss_life); any other life of 200 or more is a big enemy with a quiet bar. boss_dead is the game's own boss flag; mission_done is that flag with the fade counter the game starts as it writes MISSION COMPLETE, ten seconds after the boss. minor_min 256: entries holding exactly 255 are no enemy (five of them in Seb's game, never hit), the big natives hold 300
